title: Re-Salt Aloe Grape Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Aloe Grape by Re-Salt is a fresh and fruity taste sensation. The smooth, cool, floral freshness of Aloe is combined with the intense fruity sweetness of Grape for a truly blissful all-day vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. E-liquids formulated with nicotine salts are unique among vape products because unlike traditional freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than higher-strength freebase liquids. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Re-Salt nic salt -liquid flavours to experience. Re-Salt e-liquids are crafted in the UK with premium nicotine salts for a smooth throat hit and immense satisfaction. Explore a diverse range of mouth-watering fruit, soda, dessert, menthol, and tobacco blends, perfectly balanced with 50% VG / 50 % PG for compatibility with a wide variety of pod vapes and MTL kits. With nicotine strengths ranging from 5mg to 10mg and 20mg, find your ideal intensity and elevate your vaping experience with Re-Salt.
